title: FailureSignature
description: Draft (docs/design/m0/10 "Shared knowledge spec draft", D5): no writer, no reader and no golden vector until M2, and the shape may change before then. A derived, project-scoped aggregate of identical normalized failures (docs/plan/03-knowledge-layer.md 4.1; K4, KA8): a reason code and a normalized key with their evidence. It is regenerated from its evidence alone and never edited. The threshold lives in the project's policy, and the one deduplicated advisory proposal for a mechanism task is its own record that points to this signature. There is no clustering and no lifecycle table. Loader checks, not expressible here: count equals the number of evidence entries (the writer keeps it, the M2 loader checks it), last_seen is not before first_seen, and reason is a code a failure carries.

signature.description: The aggregate's identity: equal failures share one. Its recipe is fixed with its golden vector in M2.

reason.description: The registered reason code of the failure.

key.description: The normalized failure, one line, as the named normalizer produced it (e.g. a test node id or a check name with run-specific parts removed). The normalizer, not this pattern, keeps prose out.

count.description: Equals the number of evidence entries.

tasks.description: The distinct tasks the failure occurred in.

evidence.description: The identity digests of the receipts and attempt records it was derived from (refs, never copies).
